answer: Delay-sequencing bond: each identity climbs one ridge of sequential work before acting. Each round's output seeds the next, so fakes cannot share one machine — each pays 10 sequential minutes and a 20-credit bond. The finished proof earns a velvet seal; only a sealed identity reaches the summit. 1,000 fakes pay 10,000 minutes and 20,000 credits; one honest agent pays 10 minutes and 20 credits. Rented seals fail: they bind to the climber's key.
